text:
Priya: PTAL — I addressed the review comments on #4521. Summary: removed debug logs, split the big e2e into a focused migration test + small smoke, renamed the migration to V20260320_add_audit_index, and added a unit for the new selector. Smoke command in CI is `./scripts/smoke --profile=local-db`. Can we get a quick pass and a merge window?

Tom: looking now. quick Q — the migration filename change is safe for backports? are we keeping the version monotonic?

Priya: yep, kept monotonic and added a note in the changelog. If backport needed I can cherry-pick the migration + test only.

Ashley: ran the smoke locally, got one transient failure on the load fixture (timing). I pushed a tiny retry around the fixture, PTAL at the retry logic in the test (2 lines).

Kevin: CI shows one flaky e2e on linux-x86, job 8142. ci-bot says failures in the scheduler mock. if we can isolate that, i can queue the canary for tonight.

ci-bot: CI status: unit ✅, smoke ✅, e2e (linux-x86) ❌ — flake suspected. See https://ci.internal/8142 for logs.

Tom: ashley — can you add a short comment explaining the retry heuristic? helps reviewers.

Ashley: done. added comment and increased sleep to 50ms. PTAL.

Maria: LGTM overall. I want one more confimer from kevin on the canary timing before merge. :thumbsup:

Kevin: can confirm — if we hold canary until 22:00 PT it won't clash with the infra migration. i'll take merge custody then.

Tom: small nit — please squash the debug revert commit into the earlier change (keeps history tidy). after that i'll give formal approval.

Priya: squashed and pushed. thanks all for quick reviews. tagging @kevin for custody at 22:00 PT.

Maria: thanks! leaving a follow-up note in the PR about rollback steps. :white_check_mark:

Priya: great — i'll queue the canary with your custody note. will post outcome here when done.
